tasks.analysis: Coral reefs are diverse underwater ecosystems held together by calcium carbonate structures secreted by corals. Most reefs are built from stony corals, which consist of polyps that live in colonies. These polyps belong to a group of marine animals, which also include jellyfish. As a result, coral reefs support a wide variety of marine life and play a crucial role in ocean ecosystems. 珊瑚礁是由珊瑚分泌的碳酸钙结构支撑起来的多样化水下生态系统。大多数珊瑚礁由石珊瑚构成，而石珊瑚是由生活在群体中的珊瑚虫组成的。这些珊瑚虫属于一类海洋动物，这一类动物还包括水母。因此，珊瑚礁能够支撑丰富多样的海洋生物，在海洋生态系统中发挥着至关重要的作用。
